The present petition is filed seeking quashing of FIR No.502/2021 dated 26.08.2021, registered at Police Station Govindpuri, for offence under Section 363 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC'), on the ground that the dispute was settled with the victim and the petitioner and victim have also married each other.

2. Charges were framed against the petitioner for the offences under Sections 363/366 of the IPC,
